source_path: Floom original. Written on 2026-10-19 in Claude Code; not derived from an upstream skill. Ideas (not code) from the MIT-licensed standout CLI are credited in the internal comparison note.
note: Parses a WhatsApp Export chat file (iOS or Android, .txt or .zip, any date locale) with the Python standard library and renders a self-contained HTML page plus 1080x1920 PNG story cards. Nothing leaves the device: no network calls, no model calls, and the PNG renderer blocks every outside request. Tests use synthetic chats only.
